note: LEADS.md Part U U3. flags: a switch -> the served() counters (include/strata/core/dispatch_stats.hpp; names are string literals in src/) that must move when the switch takes the value an abtest arm gives it. up = rises, down = falls; a minus-X arm (sweep.py) reverses them. mode delta = moved by max(1, 2 percent); cross = appeared / vanished (counters of graph captures). unmapped: the other switches of tools/pancake/box_chains/sweep_candidates.json with the reason; they get no INERT verdict. Read by tools/pancake/dispatch_report.py; linted by tools/pancake/test_dispatch_report.py (every counter must exist in src/, every registry switch must be here).

STRATA_ATTN_LANECELL.why: the lane-cell decode chunk kernels (counted per graph capture)

STRATA_ATTN_MERGE_V2.why: the v2 decode merge kernel (1; 0 is the reverse)

STRATA_GDN_CHUNKED.why: the chunked prompt GDN recurrence on the matrix cores (HIP: gdn_rec_wmma in gdn_recurrence_impl)

STRATA_GR_FUSED.why: the one-launch fused kernel (needs STRATA_GR_INJ_UP and the grid barrier)

STRATA_GR_INJ_UP.why: inject rows in their own blocks (inside the a8 launch)

STRATA_GR_RDNA.why: the RDNA hyper-connection read: any of its launches (rdna_gr.cu launch<T>) appears

STRATA_GR_RDNA_A8.why: int8 activations: the a8 launches replace the q8 one (needs STRATA_GR_RDNA_Q8)

STRATA_GR_RDNA_Q8.why: int8 hc weights: the q8 / a8 launches replace the bf16 read (needs STRATA_GR_RDNA)

STRATA_HCD_EXACT.why: the exact-order hyper-connection down kernel (needs the hipBLASLt table and solution 1176 / 1177)

STRATA_PF_BK64.why: 0 runs the BK 32 kernel for wide shapes too (needs STRATA_PF_GEMM)

STRATA_PF_FUSED_NATIVE.why: 0 takes the prompt MoE off the native fused kernels (moe_fused_iq.cu experts_native)

STRATA_PF_GEMM.why: the S23 FP16 prompt GEMM (wmma_gemm.cu strata_pf_gemm_f16_ld)

STRATA_PF_HCDOWN.why: the hyper-connection down + inject as one WMMA GEMM (wmma_gemm.cu)

STRATA_WMMA_BF16.why: 0 takes the bf16 GEMMs off the WMMA kernel (needs STRATA_WMMA_GEMM)
